description: Test suite for CLI handling function 'handle_get_run_command' which verifies the correct retrieval and output of project-specific run commands based on project type. The test mocks dependencies such as 'TemplateInitInfo', 'RunTool', 'ProjectInitializer', and related factory methods, and checks the JSON output generated through print statements.

classes.name: MagicMock
classes.description: Mock class used for creating mock objects to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: patch
classes.description: Decorator/context manager to replace classes or functions with mocks during testing.

methods.name: test_get_run_command(project_type, expected_run_command)
methods.description: Parameterized test function that verifies 'handle_get_run_command' produces correct JSON output for various project types by mocking dependencies and asserting output.
